title: The Emerald City of Oz
author: L. Frank (Lyman Frank) Baum
description: "The Emerald City of Oz" by L.
longDescription: Frank Baum is a novel published in 1910. Dorothy Gale brings her Aunt Em and Uncle Henry to live permanently in Oz after financial ruin threatens their Kansas farm.

authorInfo.bio: L. Frank (Lyman Frank) Baum (1856–1919) is the author of The Emerald City of Oz. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
